scenarios.expect: New kinds coexist with unchanged legacy resource, node, BMC and boot routes and identifiers.
Kernel required; supported URL/path validation; optional initrd/params; immutable digest; no selectors, profiles, priority or overlays.
Accept only specified selector and reference fields; validate name, priority and zero-or-one discriminator; retain immutable name and UID.
Malformed JSON and conflicting reference discriminators are denied as 4xx without changing assignments, pointers or delivered artifacts.
MAC 100 beats a two-group match 25 even at lower priority; NID 75, xname 50, group 25, catch-all 1, OR not sum; normalize MAC, exact xnames/groups.
Higher priority then ascending name break equal-score ties regardless of insertion order.
Empty/default new profiles equivalent, explicit profile exact; no match delegates to unchanged legacy profile and additive scoring behavior.

POST /bootconfigs?revisionName=release-a creates series and A; PUT /bootconfigs/acceptance-os/revisions/release-b ensures B twice: 201 then 200 with same UID/digest; different B content 409 and pointers/content unchanged.
A initial default/latest; B changes latest only; canary B versus default A; promote B and roll back A; pinned A at every stage; literal tuples only.
Bare/default, latest, named and captured UID refs resolve correctly; promoter authorizes latest advancement.
Missing/stale If-Match returns 412 unchanged; simultaneous promotions with one ETag have exactly one winner.
Wrong-series, missing and retired refs return 422 unchanged; conflicting discriminators rejected unchanged.
Concurrent first PUTs with If-None-Match star have exactly one 201 and remaining 412, one record and a strong ETag.
Exact If-Match required; missing, stale or wildcard returns 412 unchanged; same-spec replay 200 with same UID and ETag; guarded delete succeeds.
Simultaneous different named updates with one ETag produce exactly one winner; stored result is the winner.
UID PUT/PATCH/DELETE share name index, reference validation, scopes and preconditions; one same-ETag competing update wins.
Collection POST is create-only 201 or duplicate 409; UID or named rename is 409 without changing identity or artifacts.
Enumerate all new collection, UID, named, status, revision, encoded and trailing-slash aliases; status cannot alter spec or pointers; no mutation gate or auth bypass.
read:boot reads; propose:boot proposes; promote:boot mutates assignments/promotes default; missing capability 403 unchanged for every applicable route.
Invalid signature, algorithm, expiry, issuer or audience yields 401 unchanged; issuer is configured TokenSmithURL and audience contains boot-service.
Auth disabled/unusable yields 503 on new management with no writes; legacy startup and public boot unchanged.
Proposer can create B without latest followers; new content with a latest follower needs promote:boot on named ensure and unnamed POST; identical replay allowed; denied state unchanged.
Concurrent latest-follower creation and proposer revision creation serialize: no unapproved latest movement becomes deployed.
Every retire attempt returns 409 boot_config_retirement_disabled; revision, UID, pin and artifacts remain unchanged; series delete and immutable spec mutation return 405.
Select highest winner before resolution; corrupted/missing winner returns 503 non-booting ipxe refusal with assignment/reference identity, never fallback.
Unknown nodes and unmatched assignments retain existing legacy modern and enabled legacy-boot behavior.
Prove actual warmed cache hit using diagnostics, then assignment/default writes take effect for requests begun after success; no stale tuple.
Changed UID/digest, assignment UID/version, profile, xname, MAC, NID, hostname, groups or template identity cannot reuse an incorrect render.
Concurrent pointer/assignment writes and reads yield complete A or complete B, never mixed kernel/initrd/arguments.
Use only SMD-seeded identity/groups/interfaces, no boot Node POST; group removal/movement visible within 5s, membership TTL at most 1s.
Expired new-path identity/membership refresh failure refuses boot, not stale content or legacy fallback.
Default and explicit dry-run write nothing; execute and dry-run are mutually exclusive; legacy record is never deleted or auto-rewritten.
Execute maps source UID to deterministic legacy revision, preserves supported semantics, retry/replay is duplicate-free and no destructive rollback on partial network failure.
Reject non-lossless multi-match/additive legacy selectors before any writes and identify offending UID.
Restart and force-recreate one writer with same durable directory retain revision/assignment UIDs, pointers and literal delivered artifacts.
Restore matching binary/data versions in isolated durable storage; UID, pointers, assignments and rendered artifacts remain identical; no downgrade claim.
